input: saved summary.json run records (initial/final parameter values and wrapped angle changes)

methods.run_colors: Matplotlib tab10 categorical palette assigned by initialization seed within each component-count group; palette reused across groups so corresponding seeds share colors.
methods.parameter_change_histograms: Grouped side-by-side counts in 10 equal bins spanning [-pi, pi]; blue/orange/green encode 2/3/4 target frequencies.
methods.parameter_spider_profiles: Seven polar spokes; radial coordinate maps wrapped angle [-pi,pi) linearly to [0,1]. Dashed is initial (1.95 pt), solid is final (2.4 pt); radial connectors are 1.95 pt. These line widths are 3x the original values.
methods.per_gate_circular_changes: For each parameter, draw all shortest signed angular arcs at radius one first, then draw all endpoints above every arc; hollow circles with thick colored outlines are initial and filled squares with dark outlines are final. Zero changes overlap exactly.
